This time [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com) writes the SQL. Copy each block
(use the copy button in its top right corner) and paste it into Gemini. Run
the blocks in order in the same chat: the table schemas tell Gemini what your
tables look like, so they have to go first.

Then copy the query Gemini writes into the DoltHub SQL editor for your
engagement database and run it. Look at the result and check that it really
answers the question.

## Table schemas

Paste this first. It shows the three tables, their columns, and how they
connect.

```sql
CREATE TABLE channels (
  channel_id int NOT NULL,
  channel_name varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (channel_id)
);

CREATE TABLE users (
  user_id int NOT NULL,
  signup_date date,
  name varchar(100),
  email varchar(100),
  address varchar(255),
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id)
);

-- opened_email, clicked_link, and converted are 1 for yes and 0 for no.
-- session_duration is in seconds. NULL means no value was recorded.
CREATE TABLE interactions (
  interaction_id int NOT NULL,
  user_id int,
  channel_id int,
  campaign varchar(100),
  opened_email tinyint,
  clicked_link tinyint,
  session_duration int,
  pages_visited int,
  converted tinyint,
  PRIMARY KEY (interaction_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (user_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (channel_id) REFERENCES channels (channel_id)
);
```

## Question 1

```default
Show the name and signup_date of every user who signed up in 2024, sorted by signup_date.
```

## Question 2

```default
Show the interaction_id, campaign, and session_duration of the 5 interactions with the longest sessions.
```

## Question 3

```default
For every interaction through the email channel that converted, show the user's name and the campaign.
```

## Question 4

```default
For each channel, show the channel_name and num_conversions, the number of interactions that converted, sorted from most conversions to fewest.
```

## Question 5

```default
Show the name and num_interactions of every user who had more than 5 interactions.
```

## Question 6

```default
Can you give me 5 more examples of natural language prompts and the corresponding SQL queries you would write for this database?
```
